verdict.rationale: Skills are transparent by design: each skill is just a directory with a SKILL.md plus optional scripts/references/assets folders (anthropic-skills-docs-52, anthropic-skills-docs-66), distributed via inspectable GitHub repos and plugin marketplaces (anthropic-skills-gh-1, anthropic-skills-docs-8), so an engineering lead can browse the repo/plugin.json and read every file before or after installing. However, there is no documented dedicated review workflow — no CLI command to list a skill's contents pre-install, no diff/preview step, no install-time file manifest or confirmation prompt described anywhere in the docs. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-install content listing/manifest feature, a documented security-review or approval workflow, and independent confirmation that engineering teams use this for safety review.
